python3 - <<'PY'
import gc
import weakref
import ringbuffer

RingBuffer = ringbuffer.RingBuffer

class Obj:
    pass


def collect():
    gc.collect()
    gc.collect()


# Basic semantics
rb = RingBuffer(2)
assert rb.is_empty() is True
assert rb.is_full() is False
assert rb.size() == 0
assert rb.capacity() == 2

a = Obj()
b = Obj()
rb.push(a)
assert rb.size() == 1
assert rb.peek() is a
assert rb.to_list() == [a]
rb.push(b)
assert rb.is_full() is True
assert rb.to_list() == [a, b]
assert rb.pop() is a
assert rb.to_list() == [b]
rb.clear()
assert rb.is_empty() is True
del a, b, rb

# Full-buffer push evicts and releases oldest object
rb = RingBuffer(2)
a, b, c = Obj(), Obj(), Obj()
wa = weakref.ref(a)
rb.push(a)
rb.push(b)
rb.push(c)  # evicts a
assert rb.to_list() == [b, c]
del a
collect()
assert wa() is None, "push eviction leaked evicted object"
del b, c, rb

# extend evicts and releases old objects
rb = RingBuffer(2)
a, b, c, d = Obj(), Obj(), Obj(), Obj()
wa, wb = weakref.ref(a), weakref.ref(b)
items = [a, b, c, d]
rb.extend(items)
assert rb.to_list() == [c, d]
del a, b, items
collect()
assert wa() is None, "extend eviction leaked first evicted object"
assert wb() is None, "extend eviction leaked second evicted object"
del c, d, rb

# resize shrinking drops oldest and releases them
rb = RingBuffer(3)
a, b, c = Obj(), Obj(), Obj()
wa = weakref.ref(a)
rb.push(a)
rb.push(b)
rb.push(c)
rb.resize(2)
assert rb.to_list() == [b, c]
del a
collect()
assert wa() is None, "resize shrink leaked dropped object"
del b, c, rb

# re-init releases old backing storage
rb = RingBuffer(2)
a, b = Obj(), Obj()
wa, wb = weakref.ref(a), weakref.ref(b)
rb.push(a)
rb.push(b)
rb.__init__(3)
assert rb.is_empty() is True
assert rb.capacity() == 3
del a, b
collect()
assert wa() is None, "re-init leaked old buffered object"
assert wb() is None, "re-init leaked old buffered object"
del rb

collect()
print("all ringbuffer leak and semantics checks passed")
PY
